method: Single-run local numerical observations, not browser/mobile frame measurements or a controlled improvement comparison. Authority creation, bounded source seeding, proof copies/hashes and GC excluded from timed stroke/dab work. Caller stats/clock overhead included. Pump batches 64 except dense reference 1. GC baselines follow event-loop yields and two forced collections. maxBytes bounds typed history payload; JS Map/object/array and VM overhead additional and bounded by counts. Completed sessions deliberately remain referenced during clear/eviction checks.
